channel.title: 重生两万年 RSS
channel.description: 重生两万年的研究型个人站，主要记录 AI治理、算法问责、技术治理、决策闭合、T-ACL 和研究写作。

item.title: Why I Understand AI Governance as a Closure Problem
item.description: Closing note for the research line. AI governance narrows to a smaller question: who is entitled to close a judgment.

item.title: 为什么我把 AI 治理理解为“闭合问题”
item.description: 研究路线收束。AI 治理的问题最后落到一个窄问题：谁有资格关闭一个判断。

item.title: What It Would Take to Implement T-ACL
item.description: Implementing T-ACL requires certificate schema, status logs, and a minimal reasoner. The formal system has to enter workflow.

item.title: 如果真的部署 T-ACL，需要什么
item.description: 部署 T-ACL 至少需要证书 schema、状态日志和最小 reasoner。形式系统必须落到工作流。

item.title: Small Claims, Clear Edges
item.description: Small claims are easier to inspect. The boundary has to narrow before evidence has a place.

item.title: How T-ACL Differs from Existing AI Governance Frameworks
item.description: T-ACL does not replace model cards, audits, or legal reasoning. It handles the next step: how materials become closure status.

item.title: T-ACL 和现有 AI 治理框架到底差在哪
item.description: T-ACL 不替代模型卡、审计或法律推理。它只处理它们之后的那一步：材料怎样变成闭合状态。

item.title: Revision Without Drama
item.description: Revision exposes how a judgment gets replaced. Old versions stay because change needs a record.

item.title: What T-ACL Is Not: Misunderstandings About Closure in AI Governance
item.description: Boundary note. T-ACL does not replace audit, legal judgment, or regulatory authority.

item.title: T-ACL 不是什么：关于 AI 治理闭合框架的几个误解
item.description: 边界澄清。T-ACL 不替代审计、法律判断或监管决定。

item.title: 写作先把话说清
item.description: 这篇只处理一件事：句子能否承受追问。漂亮不算完成，命题清楚才算开始。

item.title: AI Governance Does Not Just Need More Audits. It Needs a Way to Decide When a Case Is Closed.
item.description: The main T-ACL text. It handles the step after audits, legal reviews, and risk assessments: how materials support closure.

item.title: AI 治理真正缺的不是审计报告，而是“什么时候可以下结论”
item.description: T-ACL 主文。它处理审计、法律意见和风险评估之后的那一步：材料怎样支持闭合。

item.title: 短句、长信和一个人的网页
item.description: 个人站点的价值不在怀旧。它给版本、来源和公开身份留出固定位置。

item.title: What Does "Risk Under Control" Actually Mean?
item.description: Risk under control has to become a status. Otherwise it remains a loose line in an approval file.

item.title: “风险可控”到底是什么意思？AI 治理需要一种状态语言
item.description: “风险可控”必须落到状态语言。否则它只是审批表里的宽泛结论。

item.title: A Tool Is Never Just a Tool
item.description: Release decisions leave permissions, logs, and rollback conditions. Governance becomes visible after a tool ships.

item.title: Not Every "Failure" Means the Same Thing
item.description: A failed check may mean C, F, or a validated hard block. Treating them as one status removes the diagnostic value.

item.title: 不是所有“不通过”都一样
item.description: “不通过”至少可能指 C、F 或硬阻断。混在一起会让治理记录失去诊断功能。

item.title: Accuracy Is Not the Last Question
item.description: MiDAS and SyRI are not model-accuracy stories. Once a system enters public power, notice, appeal, and rights protection become deployment conditions.

item.title: 模型准不准，不是最后的问题
item.description: MiDAS 和 SyRI 不是模型精度故事。系统进入公共权力之后，通知、申诉和权利保障会变成部署条件。

item.title: The Three Governance Failures: Premature Acceptance, Premature Rejection, and Indefinite Delay
item.description: Premature acceptance, premature rejection, and indefinite delay are different failures. T-ACL starts by separating them.

item.title: AI 系统治理中最危险的三种错误：过早通过、过早拒绝、无限拖延
item.description: 过早通过、过早拒绝、无限拖延是三种不同失败。T-ACL 要先把它们分开。

item.title: AI Audits Are Growing. But Who Decides When They Are Enough?
item.description: More audit reports move the gap to threshold judgment. The unresolved question is who decides enough.

item.title: AI 审计报告越来越多，但谁来决定“够不够”？
item.description: 审计报告变多以后，缺口转移到阈值判断。谁来决定够不够，仍然没有固定位置。

item.title: Why I Care About Closure in AI Governance
item.description: Entry point to the T-ACL sequence. It asks who is entitled to close the matter after audit.

item.title: 我为什么关注 AI 治理中的“决策闭合”问题
item.description: T-ACL 系列入口。它只提出一个问题：审计之后，谁有资格说事情已经结束？
